title: Ibrahim and the fire
hook: Thrown into a fire… that turned cool

phrases.text: They threw him into a fire… but the fire did not harm him.
Prophet Ibrahim, peace be upon him, asked his people why they worshipped idols that could neither hear nor help them.
One day, he broke their idols into pieces, all except the biggest one.
When they asked who had done this, he said: ask them, if they can speak.
They had no answer. So they said: burn him.
They threw him into the fire. Then came the command of Allah.
Their plan failed, and Allah protected Ibrahim.
Trust in Allah can turn a fire into peace. Follow for a new story every day.

caption:
“O fire, be coolness and safety upon Ibrahim.” 🔥
The story of Prophet Ibrahim (peace be upon him), from Surah Al-Anbiya.
